mechanism: Sitagliptin may impair vitamin B12 absorption through effects on gastric acid secretion and intrinsic factor, while cyanocobalamin supplementation may be needed in some patients on long-term DPP-4 inhibitors.
action: Monitor B12 levels periodically in patients on chronic sitagliptin therapy; cyanocobalamin supplementation is appropriate if deficiency develops and can be safely coadministered.
